jobs.description:

If you enjoy working in a creative, fast-paced environment, then we would love to hear from you!

—

The Retail Division at MICHAEL KORS is a continuously growing network of more than 30 Outlets, 80 Lifestyle stores, 100 Concessions/Shop in Shops in 21 European Countries. Our EMEA Retail team is passionate, driven, multicultural and has a wonderful international spirit.

Our Sales Supervisor are reliable, empowered individuals, capable of multi-tasking in a fast-paced environment. You are an effective communicator, that delivers an elevated customer experience. Keen to collaborate, you are a team player with a positive attitude towards challenges.

• Achieve sales results through an elevated customer engagement

• Perform operational tasks with excellence

• Demonstrate flexibility and desire for individual growth in a fast-paced store environment

• Inspire customers by continually developing knowledge of current trends and styling techniques

• Collaborate with management to create innovative ways to maximize personal sales results

• Drive sales results by utilizing all available tools and technology

You’ll Need to Have:

• Relevant sales experience

• Excellent organizational and communication skills with attention of detail and accuracy

• Able to work under pressure and to thrive in a fast-paced, challenging environment

• Able to work on different tasks easily – Multi-tasking

• English Language

• Vibrant and motivated with the ability to engage, a true brand ambassador

• Ability to sell with a passion for styling and love for fashion

• Competitive compensation package

jobs.description:
Michael Kors is always interested in hearing from talented, globally-minded individuals with a passion for fashion.

If you enjoy working in a creative, fast-paced environment, then we would love to hear from you!

—

"I feel really lucky to be surrounded by such a great team. I’m not only grateful that they’ve helped me achieve my goals, but also that I can give them a place where they can achieve theirs."
- Michael Kors -

We have an exciting opportunity for a Senior General Ledger Accountant in our Manno office.

Department overview:

The General Ledger team is a key part of EMEA Finance, responsible for managing fiscal compliance in multiple countries and group reporting under US GAAP. In addition to performing high-quality monthly closing and fiscal reporting for direct and indirect taxes, the team is also responsible for managing the dynamic landscape involving new reporting requirements, process improvements and system changes. For statutory compliance, the team successfully leads the financial statement audits for nearly 30 legal entities. We work closely with many Finance teams, including FP&A, Sales Audit, Treasury, Inventory Control, but also Payroll, Legal, IT and many business partners to achieve our common goals.

What You’ll Do:

Key responsibilities include but are not limited to:

• Perform month-end, quarter-end and year-end closing activities for assigned legal entities.

• Prepare and review journal entries, accruals, prepayments and balance sheet reconciliations through Blackline.

• Ensure compliance with US GAAP and local statutory requirements.

• Support the preparation of statutory financial statements and tax return deliverables, coordinating with external auditors, tax advisors and legal advisors as needed.

• Support statutory audits, tax filings, VAT and Intrastat reporting.

• Manage intercompany accounting and reconciliations.

• Act as a key finance contact for SAP/accounting system queries and process improvements.

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives and support special projects.

• Contribute to process improvements, system changes and new reporting requirements affecting the GL function.

• Support SOX/internal control requirements and ensure appropriate documentation for key accounting activities.

You’ll Need to Have:

• 5+ years of accounting experience, preferably in an international environment

• Strong knowledge of General Ledger accounting and financial reporting; accounting certification preferred

• Experience with US GAAP, internal controls, statutory reporting, and external audits

• Excellent spoken and written English

• Advanced Excel skills and experience using SAP

MK Perks:
A purpose-driven workplace where you can grow your career, enjoy flexible benefits, and be part of a culture built on inclusion, impact, and recognition.

• Career Growth

• Clear paths for progression, leadership opportunities, and mentorship programs to help you thrive.

• Work-Life Balance & Flexibility

• Support for your well-being with flexible work options and generous time-off policies.

• Culture & Belonging

• Be part of an inclusive culture—recognized by Forbes as a Best Employer for Diversity—where diverse talent is empowered to succeed.

• Exclusive Employee Perks

• Enjoy discounts on premium products and luxury brands.

• Impact & Social Responsibility

• Contribute to global and local causes through volunteer days, sustainability programs, and charitable giving.

Michael Kors è sempre interessato ad ascoltare persone di talento e di mentalità globale con una passione per la moda.

Se vi piace lavorare in un ambiente creativo e veloce, allora ci piacerebbe sentire da voi!

.

"Sono davvero fortunato ad essere circondato da una squadra così grande. Non solo sono grato che loro.ve mi hanno aiutato a raggiungere i miei obiettivi, ma anche che posso dare loro un posto dove possono raggiungere il loro." - Michael Kors -

Abbiamo un'eccitante opportunità per un contabile capo del generale Ledger nel nostro ufficio di Manno.

Panoramica del dipartimento:

Il team General Ledger è una parte fondamentale dell'EMEA Finance, responsabile della gestione della conformità fiscale in più paesi e della segnalazione di gruppo ai sensi dei Principi contabili statunitensi. Oltre a eseguire una chiusura mensile di alta qualità e la segnalazione fiscale per le imposte dirette e indirette, il team è anche responsabile della gestione del paesaggio dinamico che coinvolge nuovi requisiti di segnalazione, miglioramenti dei processi e modifiche del sistema. Per la conformità legale, il team guida con successo i audit di bilancio per quasi 30 soggetti giuridici.

Lavoriamo a stretto contatto con molti team finanziari, tra cui FP&A, Sales Audit, Treasury, Inventory Control, ma anche Payroll, Legale, IT e molti partner commerciali per raggiungere i nostri obiettivi comuni.

Cosa farai?

Le responsabilità principali comprendono, ma non si limitano a:

• Eseguire attività di chiusura di fine mese, trimestre e fine anno per le persone giuridiche assegnate.

• Preparare e rivedere le voci di giornale, competenza, pagamenti anticipati e riconciliazione di bilancio attraverso Blackline.

• Garantire il rispetto dei requisiti dei Principi contabili statunitensi e locali.

• Sostenere la preparazione dei bilanci e dei risultati della dichiarazione dei redditi, coordinandosi con revisori esterni, consulenti fiscali e consulenti legali, se necessario.

• Sostegno ai controlli legali, ai depositi fiscali, all'IVA e alla segnalazione Intrastat.

• Gestione della contabilità interaziendale e delle riconciliazioni.

• Agire come un contatto finanziario chiave per le interrogazioni del sistema SAP/accounting e miglioramenti dei processi.

• Promuovere iniziative di miglioramento continuo e sostenere progetti speciali.

• Contribuire a migliorare i processi, modificare il sistema e nuovi requisiti di segnalazione che riguardano la funzione GL.

• Sostenere i requisiti di SOX/controllo interno e garantire la documentazione adeguata per le attività contabili fondamentali.

Dovrai avere:

• 5 anni di esperienza contabile, preferibilmente in un contesto internazionale

• Forte conoscenza della contabilità generale e della rendicontazione finanziaria; preferita la certificazione contabile

• Esperienza con i principali principali soggetti finanziari statunitensi, i controlli interni, le relazioni legali e gli audit esterni

• Eccellente inglese parlato e scritto

• Avanzate competenze ed esperienze Excel utilizzando SAP

MK Perks: Un luogo di lavoro orientato agli scopi dove è possibile crescere la carriera, godere di benefici flessibili, e di essere parte di una cultura costruita su inclusione, impatto e riconoscimento.

• Crescita della carriera

• Chiari percorsi per la progressione, le opportunità di leadership, e programmi di mentore per aiutarvi a prosperare.

• Equilibrio tra vita lavorativa e flessibilità

• Supporto per il vostro benessere con opzioni di lavoro flessibili e politiche di time-off generose.

• Cultura e appartenenza

• Fate parte di una cultura inclusiva. riconosciuta da Forbes come miglior datore di lavoro per la diversità. dove diversi talenti sono abilitati a riuscire.

• Vantaggi esclusivi per i dipendenti

• Godetevi sconti su prodotti premium e marchi di lusso.

• Impatto e responsabilità sociale

• Contribuire alle cause globali e locali attraverso i giorni di volontariato, programmi di sostenibilità e donazioni di beneficenza.

Per saperne di più sul lavoro a Michael Kors, LinkedIn pagina e MK pagina carriere.

La Società vieta anche molestie di richiedenti e dipendenti in base a una di queste categorie protette.

Michael Kors is always interested in hearing from talented, globally-minded individuals with a passion for fashion.

- MICHAEL KORS -

We have an exciting opportunity for a Payroll & Time & Attendance Integration Manager (EMEA)
in our Manno or London office.

What You’ll Do:
The Payroll & Time & Attendance Integration Manager (EMEA) will support the implementation of the Legion Time & Attendance system for HR and Payroll teams across the Michael Kors EMEA region.
The role will focus on designing and delivering automated, secure, and compliant data flows between Legion and multiple payroll software platforms used by external payroll providers across 20 European countries, eliminating manual data manipulation and reducing payroll risk.
The role will collaborate closely with HR, Payroll, Retail Operations, IT, PMO, Legion, and external payroll vendors to ensure a scalable and future‑proof payroll integration model.

Legion T&A Implementation Support

• Support the EMEA rollout of the Legion Time & Attendance system in close partnership with HR, Payroll, Retail Operations, IT, and PMO.

• Act as a functional and integration subject‑matter expert for Legion payroll‑relevant data (time, attendance, absences, overtime, premiums).

• Ensure local business needs and payroll requirements are accurately reflected in system configuration.

• Ensure labor compliance in the system such as rest periods, maximum number of working hours, etc.

Payroll Integration & Automation

• Own the end‑to‑end flow of data from Legion into all payroll systems used across EMEA.

• Analyze and map Legion outputs to the input requirements of multiple payroll software solutions used by different providers.

• Define and implement automation solutions (APIs, secure file integrations, standardized interfaces) to enable payroll processing without manual data manipulation.

• Partner with IT, Legion, and payroll vendors to establish validation rules, reconciliation processes, and exception handling frameworks.

• Design controlled workaround solutions where full automation is not supported.

Multi‑Country & Multi‑Vendor Coordination

• Serve as the primary liaison between Michael Kors and external payroll providers on all matters related to Legion data integration.

• Coordinate payroll integration testing, parallel payroll runs, and go‑live activities country by country, ensuring thorough validation and issue resolution.

• Manage timelines, dependencies, and risks linked to payroll cutoffs and statutory deadlines.

• Identify and mitigate risks related to multi-country payroll integration, including vendor dependencies, data inconsistencies, and statutory compliance requirements.

Payroll Compliance & Local Requirements

• Apply strong knowledge of European payroll rules, labor regulations, and local requirements to ensure accurate payroll data processing.

• Ensure integration meets GDPR, data security, and audit requirements.

• Document country‑specific differences, data rules, and payroll dependencies.

Governance, Documentation & Continuous Improvement

• Maintain detailed documentation of interfaces, data structures, data ownership assignments, validation rules, and country requirements.

• Audit & compliance readiness

• Identify opportunities to further simplify, standardize, and optimize payroll integrations across EMEA.

Key Stakeholders

• HR Director and HR Leadership

• EMEA Payroll Teams (internal and external)

• Retail Operations

• IT / HRIS / Integration teams

• PMO

• Legion vendor and payroll software providers

• Finance/FP&A

You’ll Need to Have:

Professional Experience

• Strong experience in Time & Attendance system implementations within the EMEA region, with good understanding of local payroll legislation and country-specific statutory requirements.

• Demonstrated expertise in payroll integration across multiple countries and payroll software platforms.

• Hands‑on experience working with external payroll providers.

• Background in:
• Payroll & T&A vendors (e.g. UKG, Replicon, Legion, or similar), or

• Consulting firms specializing in payroll, workforce management, or HR systems, or

• In‑house payroll transformation roles in international organizations.

Technical & Functional Skills

• Deep understanding of payroll‑relevant T&A data and payroll processing logic.

• Strong knowledge of payroll interfaces, file structures, APIs, and secure data transfers.

• Ability to translate payroll and HR requirements into integration specifications.

• High attention to data accuracy, controls, and auditability.

Soft Skills

• Strong stakeholder and vendor management skills.

• Ability to bridge HR, Payroll, IT, and Retail operations.

• Structured, analytical, and solution‑oriented mindset.

• Comfortable working in a fast‑paced, multi‑country, matrix environment.

Education

• Degree in Payroll, HR, Business, Information Systems, Finance, or a related field preferred, or equivalent professional experience.

What You’ll Do:
The Payroll & Time & Attendance Integration Manager (EMEA) will support the implementation of the Legion Time & Attendance system for HR and Payroll teams across the Michael Kors EMEA region.
The role will focus on designing and delivering automated, secure, and compliant data flows between Legion and multiple payroll software platforms used by external payroll providers across 20 European countries, eliminating manual data manipulation and reducing payroll risk.
The role will collaborate closely with HR, Payroll, Retail Operations, IT, PMO, Legion, and external payroll vendors to ensure a scalable and future‑proof payroll integration model.

Legion T&A Implementation Support

• Support the EMEA rollout of the Legion Time & Attendance system in close partnership with HR, Payroll, Retail Operations, IT, and PMO.

• Act as a functional and integration subject‑matter expert for Legion payroll‑relevant data (time, attendance, absences, overtime, premiums).

• Ensure local business needs and payroll requirements are accurately reflected in system configuration.

• Ensure labor compliance in the system such as rest periods, maximum number of working hours, etc.

Payroll Integration & Automation

• Own the end‑to‑end flow of data from Legion into all payroll systems used across EMEA.

• Analyze and map Legion outputs to the input requirements of multiple payroll software solutions used by different providers.

• Define and implement automation solutions (APIs, secure file integrations, standardized interfaces) to enable payroll processing without manual data manipulation.

• Partner with IT, Legion, and payroll vendors to establish validation rules, reconciliation processes, and exception handling frameworks.

• Design controlled workaround solutions where full automation is not supported.

Multi‑Country & Multi‑Vendor Coordination

• Serve as the primary liaison between Michael Kors and external payroll providers on all matters related to Legion data integration.

• Coordinate payroll integration testing, parallel payroll runs, and go‑live activities country by country, ensuring thorough validation and issue resolution.

• Manage timelines, dependencies, and risks linked to payroll cutoffs and statutory deadlines.

• Identify and mitigate risks related to multi-country payroll integration, including vendor dependencies, data inconsistencies, and statutory compliance requirements.

Payroll Compliance & Local Requirements

• Apply strong knowledge of European payroll rules, labor regulations, and local requirements to ensure accurate payroll data processing.

• Ensure integration meets GDPR, data security, and audit requirements.

• Document country‑specific differences, data rules, and payroll dependencies.

Governance, Documentation & Continuous Improvement

• Maintain detailed documentation of interfaces, data structures, data ownership assignments, validation rules, and country requirements.

• Audit & compliance readiness

• Identify opportunities to further simplify, standardize, and optimize payroll integrations across EMEA.

• EMEA Payroll Teams (internal and external)

• Retail Operations

• IT / HRIS / Integration teams

• PMO

• Legion vendor and payroll software providers

Professional Experience

• Strong experience in Time & Attendance system implementations within the EMEA region, with good understanding of local payroll legislation and country-specific statutory requirements.

• Demonstrated expertise in payroll integration across multiple countries and payroll software platforms.

• Hands‑on experience working with external payroll providers.

• Background in:
• Payroll & T&A vendors (e.g. UKG, Replicon, Legion, or similar), or

• Consulting firms specializing in payroll, workforce management, or HR systems, or

• In‑house payroll transformation roles in international organizations.

Technical & Functional Skills

• Deep understanding of payroll‑relevant T&A data and payroll processing logic.

• Strong knowledge of payroll interfaces, file structures, APIs, and secure data transfers.

• Ability to translate payroll and HR requirements into integration specifications.

• High attention to data accuracy, controls, and auditability.

Soft Skills

• Strong stakeholder and vendor management skills.

• Ability to bridge HR, Payroll, IT, and Retail operations.

• Structured, analytical, and solution‑oriented mindset.

• Comfortable working in a fast‑paced, multi‑country, matrix environment.
